name: Bug Fixes
description: Fixes bugs in the game: the crowd and announcers keep playing after a Road to the Show debut, changes you keep in the Road to the Show player editor are saved right away, and a Road to the Show save is written as soon as you name it. (No freeze before each pitch, finished tutorials, saved hub upgrades, kept custom cameras and no half-made "Joe Random" career are built into Fastball 0.2.1.)
